title: Shell completion for the canon CLI (bash, zsh, fish, tcsh)
_pr_pinning: the PR number pinned by --pr lives in the gitignored sidecar tasks/<id>/.pr-number (not in this file); --ship reads it for forge-proof merge verification. Sidecar absence is valid (legacy/pre-PR state).

escalations.reason: Code review hit 3 attempts in a row for task shell-completion (3 reviewer rounds + 0 pre-flight rejections; limit: 3). Pipeline auto-blocked before the next re-implementation. Read tasks/<id>/review.md — if the same finding keeps recurring, the spec or approach may need revisiting rather than another implementation pass. If review is still converging, raise the cap and continue — MAX_REVIEW_LOOPS=<n> canon run shell-completion. If repeated failures were all pre-flight, the handoff format itself may be wrong (e.g., Validation Outcomes rows using prose labels instead of backticked check keys). To rescope instead, run canon task reset-code-review shell-completion to archive the prior review and clear the loop-local counters. Resetting accepts the current implementation as-is, so the next run enters `code_review` without another implementation pass. Raise the cap instead if you want the deferred implementation pass to run before review. Resuming after raising the cap runs `implement` first — the deferred revision — then `code_review` again.

_verdict_values: approved | approved_with_nits | changes_requested | needs_re_review (legacy alias, routed/counted as changes_requested) | spec_gap | sanctioned (operator-only via canon task accept)
_full_send: true → skip spec gate + auto-open draft PR after clean QA. See docs/pipeline-orchestrator.md (`--full-send`).
